related.title: Atom Computing 中性原子：真空壽命與陣列存活
related.titleEn: Atom Computing neutral atoms: vacuum lifetime and array survival
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付半徑反算、2π慣例檢查與雙激發驗證計畫。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver inverse-radius checks,2π convention checks and pair-excitation validation plans. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Atom Computing 中性原子：真空壽命與陣列存活』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付單顆／陣列存活、簇集診斷及流失後恢復狀態表。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Atom Computing neutral atoms: vacuum lifetime and array survival', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver single/array survival, clustering diagnostics and post-loss recovery states.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以作用能量等於驅動能量定義教學半徑rb=(C6/(ℏΩ))^(1/6)；fR=Ω/(2π)，所以rb=r0[(V0/h)/fR]^(1/6)，括號內為無量綱頻率比。 使用合成V0/h=64 MHz於r0=3 μm、fR=1 MHz；沒有宣稱此半徑內完全零誤差。 以手算或試算表計算名義式3*(64/1)**(1/6)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：將rb代回64(3/rb)⁶應還原1或2 MHz；不可在一邊用Ω、另一邊用Hz。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：若每原子獨立指數壽命τ，N顆在t內全部存活P=exp(−Nt/τ)；共同背景事件會破壞獨立性。 使用教學N=100、τ=100 s、電路窗t=0.1 s；τ為假想有效壽命。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-100*0.1/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先算單顆exp(−t/τ)再取100次方；兩路徑必須一致。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Define teaching radius rb=(C6/(ℏΩ))^(1/6) by equal interaction and drive energies. With fR=Ω/(2π), rb=r0[(V0/h)/fR]^(1/6), using a dimensionless frequency ratio. Use Synthetic V0/h=64 MHz at r0=3 μm and fR=1 MHz; no claim of zero error inside this radius. Evaluate nominal expression 3*(64/1)**(1/6) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute rb into64(3/rb)⁶ to recover1 or2 MHz; never mix Ω on one side with Hz on the other.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For independent exponential lifetime τ per atom, all N survive time t with P=exp(−Nt/τ); common background events violate independence. Use Teaching N=100, τ=100 s and circuit window t=0.1 s; τ is a hypothetical effective lifetime. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-100*0.1/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Compute single-atom exp(−t/τ) then raise to100; both routes must agree.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Estimate accidental coincidences in independent streams and make the window convention explicit.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。兩偵測器單計數率各100000/s，總時間窗2 ns。 R偶然=10⁵×10⁵×2×10⁻⁹。 代入 1e5*1e5*2e-9，得到 20 events/s。低佔用且獨立卜瓦松計數時R偶然=R₁R₂W；W是總窗寬，非半窗。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Define teaching radius rb=(C6/(ℏΩ))^(1/6) by equal interaction and drive energies. With fR=Ω/(2π), rb=r0[(V0/h)/fR]^(1/6), using a dimensionless frequency ratio. Use Synthetic V0/h=64 MHz at r0=3 μm and fR=1 MHz; no claim of zero error inside this radius. Evaluate nominal expression 3*(64/1)**(1/6) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Substitute rb into64(3/rb)⁶ to recover1 or2 MHz; never mix Ω on one side with Hz on the other.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Each detector records100000/s; the full coincidence window is2 ns. Racc=10^5×10^5×2×10^-9. Substituting 1e5*1e5*2e-9 gives 20 events/s. For low-occupancy independent Poisson streams Racc=R1R2W; W is full width, not half width. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
